module_summary: 16-bit XNOR-feedback LFSR pseudo-random replacement selector, outputting its low bits as a one-hot and binary refill way.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: 16-bit LFSR state register; low bits index the refill way outputs.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Advance enable: shifts the LFSR by one step when high.

anchors.name: refill_way_oh_o
anchors.why: One-hot refill way decoded from LFSR low bits.

anchors.name: refill_way_bin_o
anchors.why: Binary refill way taken from LFSR low bits.

anchors.name: shift_in
anchors.why: XNOR feedback of taps 15, 12, 5, 1 shifted into LFSR.

groups.name: LFSR
groups.description: Enable-gated 16-bit LFSR with XNOR tap feedback and seed reset.

groups.name: Way decode
groups.description: One-hot and binary refill-way outputs from LFSR low bits.
